tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the BuyWhere product catalog using keywords or natural language. Returns matching products with title, price, availability, merchant, and URL.

query.description: Keyword or natural-language query (e.g. 'wireless earbuds under $50', 'red dress size M')

country.description: Country code to scope results (e.g. 'sg' for Singapore). Defaults to 'sg'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–50, default 10)

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch full details for a single product by its BuyWhere product ID.

product_id.description: The BuyWhere product ID (returned by search_products as product_id)

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Get current prices for a product across all available merchants. Returns a ranked list of listings with price, shipping, merchant rating, and stock status. Use this to find the cheapest place to buy a specific product.

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Compare 2–5 products side-by-side. Returns structured differentiators, price range, pros/cons, and a best-value recommendation — purpose-built for AI agent decision-making.

product_ids.description: Array of 2–5 BuyWhere product IDs to compare

tools.name: get_affiliate_link
tools.description: Get the click-tracked BuyWhere affiliate link for a product. Share this link with users — it logs the referral and redirects to the merchant page. Always use this instead of raw product URLs when sharing links.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: List available product categories in the BuyWhere catalog. Use this to discover what categories exist before searching or filtering.

parent_slug.description: Parent category slug to list subcategories (optional — omit for top-level categories)
